craft_notes: Work voice holds (quatrain, dash breaths); closing song of the work, sthāyin: śānta as the festival of the abode — bhakti in the mode of utsava (festival), vyabhicāri adbhuta that everything is wonderful for the wise. Verse color: definitions by vanishing erupting into festival (v3 said all IS yoga; v4 says each form is known by what has dropped out of it — recognition deepens). Firing rows: strict yasmin/yatra/yataḥ parallel (rows 3+9) → 'That…where…' anaphora ×3, the structural rhyme answering v3's 'Whatever ×3'; three DISTINCT verbs pratibhāti/samudeti/prathate → kept distinct (each form shines differently — variety is doctrine); doubled kim kim (L0 p025–p026) → the stammer kept, it IS the camatkāra; tvad second person (row 7) → 'Your' prominent, distance collapsed; sudhī open (BOUNDARY) → L3's 'of the wise' kept, note carried. FULL-LAYER AUDIT: L0 no forks; NOTE's 'Three definitions by vanishing, in strict yasmin/yatra/yataḥ parallel' + 'it ends in festival' is the draft's skeleton — analysis sung, not decorated. REJECTED OPTIONS (with killers): (a) L3 couplet kept → killed by work-voice quatrain + three definitions need three breaths. (b) flattening shines/arises/spreads to one verb → killed by Sanskrit: three verbs, three musics; flattening sanitizes variety. (c) single 'what' (smoothing the stammer) → killed by doubled kim kim: undoubling calms the camatkāra. (d) resolving sudhī to 'the good-minded' → killed by BOUNDARY (unresolved). (e) 'dissolved' for galitā over L3's 'melted away' → killed by rule 15, L3 frozen; both trace p012. (f) exclamatory close ('how wonderful!') → killed by v2 precedent + row 10: the question affirms, exclamation states. Read aloud: three That-lines gathering by vanishing, one festival question — the song ends open, shining. SELF-CAUGHT PRE-VERDICT: first draft carried a sandhi-normalized cite reconstructed from memory; byte-check against L3 failed, replaced with exact L3 string. The check exists because memory smooths — this is the error it is for.

lines: That mantra shines where no pattern of letters can be traced;
That mudrā rises where every bodily act has melted away.
That yoga spreads where the breath's flowing is spent;
in the festivals of attaining Your abode, of the wise — what, what is not wonderful?
notes: sudhī kept genitive ('of the wise'); vocative reading open (per L3)
l4.sanskrit_cite: mantraḥ sa pratibhāti varṇaracanā yasminna saṃlakṣyate mudrā sā samudeti yatra galitā kṛtsnā kriyā kāyikī | yogaḥ sa prathate yataḥ pravahaṇaṃ prāṇasya saṃkṣīyate tvaddhāmādhigamotsaveṣu sudhiyāṃ kiṃ kiṃ na nāmādbhutaṃ
